result.brief: 提出以持久分层记忆（结构/场景/实例 token）锚定的驾驶世界模型，并用在线 flow-matching RL 优化自生成 rollout，缓解长时序漂移与质量衰减。
result.reason: Autoregressive driving world model with persistent hierarchical memory tokens and online flow-matching RL for long-horizon rollout consistency; contributes to video world modeling and long video generation.
